detailed_description: The YAML Validator checks YAML syntax in the browser using the js-yaml library. Paste YAML into the textarea, click Validate, and the tool reports whether the document is valid or shows the first parse error with a line marker. The page also displays the parsed data as formatted JSON so you can inspect the structure. It does not support multiple documents, schema validation, anchor/alias resolution, custom tags, file upload, download, or production-grade error recovery.
usage_steps: Paste YAML content into the textarea.
Click Validate to parse the input with js-yaml.
Read the validity message and check the line marker if an error is shown.
Inspect the parsed JSON structure below the validation result.
Fix any reported issues and re-validate.
usage_examples: Quickly check a short YAML snippet for syntax errors before pasting it into a config file.
Inspect the parsed structure of a simple YAML document as formatted JSON.
Verify that a hand-edited YAML value is still valid after manual changes.
Use the line marker to locate a missing colon or incorrect indentation in a draft.
